write_up: This is a strong pharmacy technician resume. Your inpatient work covers sterile compounding, cabinet restocking and training, with enough detail for a recruiter to see what your shifts involve.

The cabinet restocking line is the model: it names the six nursing units and puts the stockout reports alongside the work. Your certifications and license are easy to find. The main structural snag is that duties sit apart from the employers and dates, so a recruiter has to match them up.

Let's put each set of duties under its corresponding role, starting with Sutter Valley Medical Center. Your resume makes a strong case on its own; competition for a particular hospital job and a referral can still matter.
